This article compares the incidence of [[iskaemisk-apopleksi|ischemic stroke]] among prevalent patients with [[atrieflimren-i-danmark|atrial fibrillation]] in Denmark, categorized by their anticoagulant treatment groups. The data, drawn from the Danish National Patient Register (LPR), tracks how many patients developed a stroke during the reporting periods covered by the 2023 and 2024 reports.

Across both reporting periods, the overall rate of ischemic stroke among all atrial fibrillation patients remained remarkably stable, rising marginally from 0.82% (1,104 patients) in the 2023 report to 0.83% (1,132 patients) in the 2024 report [^src1] [^src2]. When examining specific treatment groups, patients receiving a combination of both [[doac|DOAC]] and [[marevan|marevan]] consistently recorded the highest stroke rates, acting as the clear outliers in both datasets. In 2023, 2.89% of patients on combination therapy suffered a stroke, and this rate increased to 3.46% in 2024 [^src1] [^src2]. 

Conversely, the lowest stroke rates were generally found among patients receiving monotherapy or no anticoagulant treatment. In the 2023 data, patients receiving neither DOAC nor Marevan had the lowest stroke rate at 0.53%, closely followed by those on DOAC or Marevan alone at 0.56% [^src1]. By the 2024 report, patients on Marevan alone recorded the lowest stroke rate at 0.51%, while those on neither medication saw a slight increase to 0.59% [^src2]. 

Notably, the data presents some structural anomalies in how treatment groups are categorized or reported across the two years. In the 2023 table, the rows for DOAC and Marevan monotherapy report identical patient counts (8,486 without stroke and 48 with stroke) [^src1]. In the 2024 table, the rows for "AK-behandling" (anticoagulant treatment overall) and DOAC report identical counts (101,313 without stroke and 902 with stroke), suggesting that DOAC may have entirely subsumed the broader AK-behandling category in that specific year's breakdown [^src2]. Despite these reporting quirks, the overarching trend highlights that combination therapy carries a substantially higher risk of ischemic stroke compared to monotherapy or no treatment.

| AK-behandling | 95919 | 99.11 | 865 | 0.89 |
| DOAC | 8486 | 99.44 | 48 | 0.56 |
| Marevan | 8486 | 99.44 | 48 | 0.56 |
| Både DOAC og Marevan | 1445 | 97.11 | 43 | 2.89 |
| Hverken DOAC eller Marevan | 27856 | 99.47 | 148 | 0.53 |

Entities: doac, marevan

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner forekomsten af iskæmisk apopleksi blandt atrieflimren-patienter efter behandlingsgruppe (DOAC, Marevan, kombination eller ingen), baseret på LPR-data.
